        while True:

                raise ValueError("unterminated string")
            c = text[pos]
            if c == '"':
                pos += 1
                return ''.join(chars)
            if c == '\\':

                if pos >= n:
                    raise ValueError("unterminated string")
                esc = text[pos]
                pos += 1
                if esc == '"':
                    chars.append('"')
                elif esc == '\\':
                    chars.append('\\')
                elif esc == '/':
                    chars.append('/')
                elif esc == 'b':
                    chars.append('\b')
                elif esc == 'f':
                    chars.append('\f')
                elif esc == 'n':
                    chars.append('\n')
                elif esc == 'r':
                    chars.append('\r')
                elif esc == 't':
                    chars.append('\t')
                elif esc == 'u':
                    if pos + 4 > n:
                        raise ValueError("invalid \\u escape")
                    h = text[pos:pos+4]
                    for ch in h:
                        if ch not in '0123456789abcdefABCDEF':
                            raise ValueError("invalid \\u escape")
                    pos += 4
                    code = int(h, 16)
                    if 0xD800 <= code <= 0xDBFF:
                        if pos + 6 > n:
                            raise ValueError("invalid surrogate")
                        if text[pos] != '\\' or text[pos+1] != 'u':
                            raise ValueError("invalid surrogate")
                        h2 = text[pos+2:pos+6]
                        for ch in h2:
                            if ch not in '0123456789abcdefABCDEF':
                                raise ValueError("invalid surrogate")
                        pos += 6
                        low = int(h2, 16)
                        if not (0xDC00 <= low <= 0xDFFF):
                            raise ValueError("invalid surrogate")
                        combined = 0x10000 + ((code - 0xD800) << 10) + (low - 0xDC00)
                        chars.append(chr(combined))
                    elif 0xDC00 <= code <= 0xDFFF:
                        raise ValueError("lone low surrogate")
                    else:
                        chars.append(chr(code))
                else:
                    raise ValueError("invalid escape")
            elif ord(c) < 0x20:
                raise ValueError("control character in string")
            else:
                chars.append(c)
                pos += 1

        if text[pos] == '0':
